card.name: Interacting drug names in interaction text
card.fires_on: The name of a second drug or drug class (often partway through it) in drug-interaction statements, right after 'X and' or 'between X and'. It also fires on the closing part of names like inducers, inhibitors, contraceptives.

modes.label: After 'and' naming partner drug
modes.description: The start of the interacting drug right after 'and' or 'between ... and'.
modes.example: dolutegravir The interaction between INTELENCE and the<< drug>> was evaluated in a clinical study. All

modes.label: Inside interacting drug or class name
modes.description: Later pieces of a drug or class name that is being paired with the labeled drug.
modes.example: 3A4 Inducers Clinical Impact: The concomitant use of trazodone hydrochloride and strong CYP3A4 indu<<cers>> decreased the exposure of trazodone

card.plain: It lights up on the name of the other drug when a label describes how two medicines interact.
